Mira (AM): Kickoff: EchoSys needs SAML SSO + SCIM bulk (~350k users) + group->role RBAC. They might require an on-prem air-gapped prod deploy. Need blockers and a pricing sketch by Wed.
Dev (SE): Quick Qs: hourly deltas OK? Any requirement for immediate revocation when group membership changes?
Cal (Eng): Hourly deltas are fine for most. For immediate revocation use SAML assertions + short session TTLs. For 350k bulk import recommend chunks of 2k-6k and concurrency ~10. Backoff: base 1s, max 60s with jitter.
Noah (Infra): Air-gapped: we need full network diagram, host inventory, RTO/RPO, and a signed SOW. Zero control-plane access adds ~15% support uplift and a one-time deployment fee.
Dev (SE): RBAC pattern: SCIM groups->roles for bootstrap and periodic syncs; SAML for runtime enforcement. We can emit webhooks for near-real-time updates but scale limited.
sec-bot: sec-bot: sent security pack + SOC2 artifact link -> https://redwood.example.com/sec/echosys
Mira (AM): Action items: (1) Mira request network diagram + SAML metadata + peak QPS; (2) Cal publish SCIM runbook + sample payloads; (3) Dev draft pricing bands (Dedicated reserved vs Hosted fallback vs air-gap uplift). Sync Tue EOD. :thumbsup:
